'''Baktoid Industries''' was a holding corporation that controlled the interests of [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]], [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]], and [[Baktoid Fleet Ordnance/Legends|Baktoid Fleet Ordnance]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
